entries.title: Add the bus logger
entries.explanation: Register first_steps_log with the pyRBS bus logger handler. Because no channel filter is supplied, the trace records the available CAN channels, including CAN1 and CAN2.

entries.title: Start and stop with the simulation
entries.explanation: Start recording when the simulation starts. Stop the logger during shutdown so pyRBS closes the session and exports the MF4 log file.
